checkedAlternates.risk: Buckwheat has "wheat" in its English name.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Buckwheat is a dicot in Polygonaceae (group-1), completely unrelated to grass-family wheat (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Quinoa and Buckwheat are both pseudocereals.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Quinoa and Amaranth belong to Amaranthaceae (group-2), whereas Buckwheat belongs to Polygonaceae (group-1).
